signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the email and password you use for Shakti Prime on the website.
signIn.codeHint: Open the authenticator app on your phone and type the 6-digit code for Shakti Prime.

unlock.chooseIntro: You'll use these 4 digits to open the app. Pick numbers that are easy for you to remember and hard for others to guess.
unlock.confirmIntro: Type the same 4 digits once more.
unlock.mismatch: The two PINs don't match. Choose your PIN again.
unlock.wrong: That PIN is not right. {count, plural, one {You have # try left.} other {You have # tries left.}}
unlock.tooManyTries: Too many wrong PINs. For your safety you've been signed out. Sign in again with your email and password.

today.title: Today
today.emptyBody: Your visits and jobs will show here once your manager schedules them.
today.offline: You're offline. You can keep working; your changes will be sent when you're back online.

settings.title: Settings
settings.signOutConfirm: You'll need your email and password to sign in again.

update.title: Update the app
update.body: This version of Shakti Field is too old to keep working. Update it from the Play Store, then open it again.
update.yours: Your version {version}. Oldest version that works: {minimum}.

errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
errors.totp_required: Type the code from your authenticator app.
errors.totp_invalid: That code didn't work. Wait for a new code in your authenticator app and type it.
errors.totp_setup_required: Your role needs an authenticator app. Set it up on the website first, then sign in here.
errors.account_locked: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes before you try again.
errors.account_suspended: This account is not active. Ask your manager to check it.
errors.refresh_expired: You've been away for a while. Please sign in again.
errors.refresh_reused: For your safety this phone was signed out. Please sign in again.
errors.device_revoked: This phone was signed out. Please sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes before you try again.
errors.offline: No internet connection. Check your signal and try again.
errors.unavailable: Signing in isn't working right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.validation_failed: Check the email and password and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a few minutes.
